paragraphs: OnSight sells equipment intelligence to gyms, tracking a full facility so operators can make decisions, drive retention, and save costs. Non-invasive sensors mount to the wall and read treadmills, cable stacks, racks and free weights with no disruption to the floor. Usage streams wirelessly to the cloud in real time, with no manual logging.

Heatmaps, utilization, and preventative maintenance land in one dashboard. Machine usage tracking shows which stations carry the load and which collect dust, so assets can be rotated and the floor laid out around how members train. Service is scheduled on real usage hours rather than calendar dates.
Automated insights combine recorded data with an algorithm to say how equipment should be bought, sold, and rotated.

quote.text: Equipment Intelligence for Gyms. OnSight tracks your full facility and gives you the insights necessary to make decisions, drive retention, and save costs.
